queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Rocket.Chat %' AND publisher = 'Rocket.Chat Support';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Rocket.Chat %' AND publisher = 'Rocket.Chat Support' AND version_compare(version, '4.19.0') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'rocket.chat.exe');
